courseBuilder.title: Course builder
courseBuilder.description: Describe a topic or practice in your own words — the AI writes the notes, splits them into knowledge atoms and builds a course with lessons and practice. Or upload your materials (pdf, docx, txt, md).

stageHint.EXTRACTING: Extracting text from materials or writing notes for the topic, splitting into atoms
stageHint.OUTLINING: The AI extracts knowledge nodes citing atoms; citations are verified by code
stageHint.GENERATING: Writing lessons per module: theory, quiz, gaps, practice
stageHint.READY: Draft is ready — review and accept to create the course
stageHint.FAILED: Failed — try refining the topic or uploading another file

form.modeTopicHint: No notes: describe the topic, lesson plan or practice — the AI writes the notes itself.
form.modeMaterialsHint: Upload notes, a handbook or slides — text is extracted automatically.
form.filesHint: pdf, docx, txt, md — up to 50 MB each
form.topicHint: At least {{chars}}. E.g. "for and while loops in Python, list practice, grade 7, 2 lessons"
form.topicExtraTooShort: Too short: at least {{chars}}, or leave the field empty
form.topicPlaceholder: What to learn, for whom, what practice is needed
form.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. more practice, short texts, quiz at the end
form.title: Course title

job.title: Course generation

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.emptyHint: Assign homework — AI will build it from your materials or description

clubDemand.title: Club demand
clubDemand.description: From the AI tutor onboarding: who enrolled right away, who marked “maybe later”, who was shown a club and skipped it. This is demand, not attendance.
clubDemand.empty: No student has completed onboarding yet
clubDemand.futureHint: What students want to try later — ideas for new clubs

assign.title: Assign homework
assign.targetHomeworkHint: A single lesson: theory, a check and practice. Lands in the group course right after you accept the draft.
assign.targetCourseHint: Several modules from large materials. You can edit the draft and publish it yourself.
assign.courseHint: Homework can go into the same course — the student keeps going through it
assign.dueAtHint: Optional. Without a due date the assignment stays open
assign.name: Title
assign.nameHint: Optional — AI will come up with one
assign.sourceTopicHint: Describe the topic — AI writes the notes and builds the lesson from them
assign.sourceMaterialsHint: pdf, docx, txt or md — AI reads the text and builds the lesson from it
assign.topicPlaceholder: For example: revise multiplying fractions, 8 problems with common mistakes, year 6

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.pickLesson: Pick the lesson you are marking
attendance.emptyLessonsHint: Attendance is marked per lesson from the group schedule

invite.title: Invite students
invite.description: Send the link to students in MAX: they open it and join the group in one tap. The link is reusable — one for the whole group.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the link and copy it manually
invite.resetHint: The old link stops working — useful if it was shared with the wrong people
invite.resetDone: Link updated, the old one no longer works
